proposals.sentence: Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band.
proposals.quotation: OET Results: At least two subtest results in the Band 450-500 and two subtest results in the Band 400-500 are required.

proposals.sentence: The OET results must be no more than two years old on the date of application.
proposals.quotation: OET results must be no more than two-years old at the date of application

proposals.sentence: Applicants who are not exempt must show they have passed the OET or IELTS.
proposals.quotation: All other applications will need to provide evidence of successfully completing either the OET or IELTS.

proposals.sentence: Applicants with an entry-level speech pathology degree taught in English at a university in the UK, USA, Canada, New Zealand or Ireland do not need the OET or IELTS.
proposals.quotation: if they hold an entry level speech pathology qualification undertaken in English from a University in the UK, USA, Canada, New Zealand, or the Republic of Ireland
